result.summary: Identified two visual layout and content issues on the food delivery interface.

issues.description: Food items use generic vector illustrations rather than standard food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder vector graphics with high-quality photographs of menu items.

issues.description: Restaurant title text is cut off at the right edge of the screen card without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text wrapping or add truncation ellipsis for long restaurant names.
